description: Recommended Claude Code hooks configuration for Stock Agent

runs: /check-security - Scan for exposed API keys and secrets
/lint-agent - Check Python code quality and style
pre_commit.purpose: Prevent committing broken or insecure code
pre_commit.benefit: Catches issues before they reach remote repo

post_commit.purpose: Keep documentation in sync with code changes
post_commit.benefit: Docs are always current and accurate

pre_push.benefit: Ensures remote repo only gets tested code

on_open.when: When project is opened in Claude Code

post_fetch.when: After pulling changes from remote (git pull)
runs: /validate-config - Verify new code works with current setup
post_fetch.purpose: Ensure pulled changes don't break local setup

typical_development_day: 1. Open project → on_open fires → Validates config
3. git commit → pre_commit fires → Security check + lint + test
4. Commit succeeds → post_commit fires → Docs auto-update
5. git push → pre_push fires → Final tests before remote push
6. Team member git pull → post_fetch fires → They validate setup
security_benefit: Tries to commit with exposed API key
Developer sees error: 'API key found in config.py'

how_to_install.step1: Locate your Claude Code settings file
how_to_install.step2: Open the settings file in your editor
how_to_install.step4: Copy the hooks configuration from this file

customization_tips.tip1: Reduce pre_commit if too slow: Remove /test-agent for faster commits
customization_tips.tip2: Add more validation: Chain more skills with &&
customization_tips.tip3: Run skills in parallel (experimental): Use ; instead of &&
customization_tips.tip3_note: This runs all regardless of failures
customization_tips.tip4: Disable a hook: Comment it out or remove it
customization_tips.tip5: Add conditional logic: Use bash if statements

hooks_not_running: 1. Verify hooks are in ~/.claude/settings.json (not settings.local.json only)
2. Check that skill.md is in project root
hook_blocking_commits: 1. This is intentional! Hooks prevent bad commits
2. Fix the issue the hook found

security_note: Pre-commit hooks act as a safety net. They catch issues before they reach the remote repository, protecting your API keys and code quality.
